coverage.scope: Independent full-size source-pixel observation of eight short arms plus two long feeding tentacles, both eyes, siphon and fin skirt
coverage.landmarkMethod: Manual source points and priority boundary polygons, no donor coordinates or hidden-root inference. Roots name painted emergence boundaries, never invisible attachments.
coverage.contourCorrection: Source-observed complete outer contours after existing priority owners, plus central real arm crown as root. Corrects omitted sucker/fin/arm-edge strips; preserves source RGBA, all landmarks and all 38 anatomical joints.
